acceptance_criteria: Every registered degradation cause has one safe label, impact tier, owner/action class, and clear-policy identifier.
The fleet API rejects or explicitly classifies unregistered, malformed, empty-on-degraded, and contradictory cause vectors.
The console renders the actual cause for every registered single-cause fixture.
Multi-cause fixtures show deterministic dominance and the complete bounded membership list.
Stale or carried evidence is visibly distinct from a current observation.
Missing, invalid, or unknown evidence never renders as an ordinary healthy or known cause.
Cause recovery is member-aware and does not erase still-active siblings.
Exact serialized API and rendered UI tests contain no raw identity, path, message, provider output, exception prose, credential, or topology values.
#2451's registry guard fails if a new emitter cause lacks the required safe projection metadata and behavior test.
blast_radius: Fleet health classification and line API stability, console fleet/deployment/detail diagnosis, cause freshness and multi-cause recovery semantics, accessibility of operator-facing degradation state, and privacy of bounded health projections.
evidence_summary: Three live reads spanning 25 seconds pinned open issue #2537 to node I_kwDOR1Sep88AAAABKQkZOg, the current title, labels, update time, URL, and exact 6,584-byte body hash while local origin/main and the SSH remote main remained 9a1bd7b3d3c529b276c1ad764d2c312d7f3abfc3. Exact-main source inspection shows core health emits degradation_causes and the fleet poller parses the vector into free-form statusEvidence while retaining the generic health_body_degraded reason. The lines route transports statusReason, statusEvidence, and raw health. Console LineInstance declares statusEvidence but its health type has no degradation_causes field; the only executable statusReason consumer is DeploymentCard, which renders the generic reason, and console source has zero degradation_causes consumers. The untouched exact-main core-health, fleet-poller, lines-route, and deployment-page suites passed 354 of 354 tests. A scan of all 38 open PRs, with full pagination of the two PRs exceeding 100 files, found no owner. Draft PR #2451 is partial vocabulary work, merged PR #2051 is partial producer/poller history, and every other open match below is collision-only.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding is falsified if the line API validates and projects registered bounded cause objects with freshness and multi-cause semantics and the console renders those causes independently of generic statusReason text. Exact-main producer-to-consumer tracing disproved those conditions: the vector reaches fleet evidence but has no typed line projection or console consumer. This review did not create the proposed generated cause matrix or browser-level accessibility and recovery tests; the 354 green existing tests establish current transport and generic rendering behavior rather than the missing cause-aware contract.
impact: Operators see a generic degraded label even when the backend already knows the exact causes. They cannot reliably distinguish fallback, transport, auth, schema, durability, recovery, or unknown states, determine cause freshness, or know whether one member of a multi-cause episode recovered without inspecting unstructured evidence.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2537 immediately before registry integration and reject this record if its state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm the SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and decisive source bytes before implementation.
Consume #2447 and draft PR #2451's canonical bounded vocabulary rather than creating a second console-only cause registry.
Land the runtime cause contract from #2538 before requiring complete non-agent cause projection; keep #2409 alert policy and #2515 authorization ownership separate.
Add RED and GREEN fleet fixtures for registered single and multi-cause vectors, missing, empty-on-degraded, malformed, unknown, contradictory, stale, and carried observations.
Add console fixtures for dominant cause, full bounded membership, freshness, availability, accessible text and tooltips, and member-aware recovery.
Require exact serialized and rendered privacy checks excluding raw errors, identities, paths, messages, provider output, credentials, and topology.
Coordinate the large collision-only console preservation PRs #2078, #2500, and #2501 without treating them as semantic owners.
Verify the public projection does not require the console to parse free-form statusEvidence or raw health detail fields.
Re-scan all open PR references and changed files immediately before dispatch; this audit found no open implementation owner.
